waves.gate: No v1 source mutation until release-state ambiguity, repo cleanliness, source identity and rollback anchor are resolved.
waves.goal: Establish one reproducible 0.9.0 source baseline and close/supersede the pending release boundary before re-architecture.
waves.name: Baseline freeze and campaign boundary

waves.gate: Every modeled source/operational object resolves deterministically; zero address collisions; generated projections declare dependencies and status.
waves.goal: Create path-independent entity identity, locator/relation layers, compact aliases, generation vector and universal projection currentness.
waves.name: Semantic identity, generation and currentness foundation

waves.gate: Dry-run reaches a fixed point with zero unresolved owners/imports/evidence references; apply is transactional and exactly reversible.
waves.goal: Use the semantic foundation to reorganize physical structure without breaking historical identity, imports, evidence or consumers.
waves.name: Transactional remap and migration compiler

waves.gate: Adversarial concurrency proves stale turns/callbacks/cleanup cannot mutate current state; terminal persistence barrier is reliable.
waves.goal: Make execution identity, activation ownership, mutation fencing, approval/CAS and cancellation coherent across extension and Python.
waves.name: Universal execution and authority transaction spine

waves.gate: Crash/fault vectors recover or stop closed; resume never skips unverified effect; stale derived state cannot masquerade as current.
waves.goal: Make effects, resume, projections and caches crash-consistent, dependency-aware and auditable.
waves.name: Durability, recovery, checkpoints, cache and trace lineage

waves.gate: Memory can be rebuilt/audited from observations; promotion cannot bypass governance; context packs are deterministic for identical generations.
waves.goal: Generalize localized operational learning and create efficient, generation-bound context packaging for Librarian/Laya/retrieval.
waves.name: Object-local adaptive memory and context intelligence

waves.gate: Every node has one resolved capability/owner/authority context; budget/quota failure states are explicit; no direct provider bypass route remains.
waves.goal: Compile logical work into governed TaskExecutionPlans and place it using hard constraints, provider truth, budgets and live resource state.
waves.name: Execution Graph Fabric, provider truth and resource placement

waves.gate: Observer outage is visible; high-risk effects fail closed; PASS cannot be produced by missing, skipped or stale proof.
waves.goal: Independently observe execution/effects, enforce high-risk boundaries and validate full workflows with explicit fidelity and evidence.
waves.name: Observation, containment and Full Spectrum Verification

waves.gate: Single-mutation self-ops proves rollback and independent verification before recursive mode can be enabled.
waves.goal: Round out durable workflows and activate bounded improvement only after execution, recovery and verification substrates are trustworthy.
waves.name: Workflow/skill hardening, experiments and Self Operations

waves.gate: Build capability and runtime qualification are distinct; optional backends fail cleanly and never become mandatory core dependencies.
waves.goal: Add model transformation/optimization lineage and external compute backends as optional evidence-backed placements without bloating core authority.
waves.name: Model lifecycle, optimization and AMD/ROCm capability track

waves.gate: UI/docs are projections of canonical owners, not shadow state; claims are testable against generated/runtime truth.
waves.goal: Project one canonical runtime truth into UI/docs and make the v1 architecture understandable, testable and governable.
waves.name: Operator surfaces, docs, ADR and governance convergence

waves.gate: The exact artifact tested is the exact artifact packaged/installed/certified; no mutations after evidence seal starts.
waves.goal: Prove the entire re-architecture as one unchanged artifact and seal evidence only after deterministic convergence.
waves.name: Fixed point, installed-host certification and v1 release
